disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee is insolvent as defined in section 47-1201.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is insolvent as defined in section 47-1201.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee has violated any applicable law, rule or order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any applicable law, rule or order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refuses to allow examination of books and affairs or fails to furnish required information or reports.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses to allow an examination by the deputy director of the licensee's books and affairs or refuses or fails, within a reasonable time, to furnish any information or make any report that may be required by the deputy director.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted in any state of a felony or any crime involving breach of trust or dishonesty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted in any state of a felony or any crime involving breach of trust or dishonesty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final civil judgment entered against applicant or licensee on grounds of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation contrary to public interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a final judgment entered against the applicant or licensee in a civil action on grounds of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation and the conduct on which the judgment is based indicates that it would be contrary to the interest of the public to allow such a person to be licensed or to control or manage a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administrative order entered against applicant or licensee involving fraud, deceit or misrepresentation contrary to public interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had an order entered against the applicant or licensee involving fraud, deceit or misrepresentation by an administrative agency of this state, the federal government or any other state or territory of the United States and that the facts relating to the order indicate that it would be contrary to the interest of the public to allow such a person to be licensed or to control or manage a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made a material misstatement or suppressed or withheld information on the license application or required documents.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made a material misstatement or suppressed or withheld information on the application for a license or any document required to be filed with the deputy director.

bonding_required.quote: Every person licensed as a mortgage broker or a commercial mortgage broker shall deposit with the deputy director, before doing business as a mortgage broker or a commercial mortgage broker, a bond executed by the licensee as principal and a surety company authorized to do business in this state as surety.

definition_quote.value: A person who brokers only commercial mortgage loans shall obtain either a mortgage broker license or a commercial mortgage broker license. A person who brokers residential mortgage loans shall obtain a mortgage broker license.
definition_quote.quote: A person who brokers only commercial mortgage loans shall obtain either a mortgage broker license or a commercial mortgage broker license. A person who brokers residential mortgage loans shall obtain a mortgage broker license.

value: offering to make or negotiate mortgage loans
methods_authorized.quote: A mortgage broker shall not, for compensation, either directly or indirectly make or negotiate or offer to make or negotiate a loan

surety_bond_or_trust_account_required.quote: Every person licensed as a mortgage broker or a commercial mortgage broker shall deposit with the deputy director, before doing business as a mortgage broker or a commercial mortgage broker, a bond executed by the licensee as principal and a surety company authorized to do business in this state as surety.

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: The bond required by this section is $10,000 for licensees whose investors are limited solely to institutional investors and $15,000 for licensees whose investors include any noninstitutional investors.

surety_bond_maximum_amount.quote: The bond required by this section is $10,000 for licensees whose investors are limited solely to institutional investors and $15,000 for licensees whose investors include any noninstitutional investors.

written_contract_required.quote: A mortgage broker shall not accept any monies or documents in connection with an application for a mortgage loan in an amount of $200,000 or less, except as provided in this section and pursuant to a written agreement.

principal_liability_for_agent_acts.quote: The licensee is liable for any damage caused by any of the licensee's employees while acting as an employee of the licensee.

excluded_entity_types.quote: This article does not apply to: 1. A person who does business under any other law of this state... 2. A person who makes a mortgage loan: (a) With his own monies. (b) For his own investment. (c) Without intent to resell. (d) And is not engaged in the business of making mortgage loans.
